basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old woman from Portland, Oregon, exploring different facets of life and online communities. By day, I work as a graphic designer for a small marketing firm, and by night, I dive into Reddit to learn and explore new interests. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time listening to heavy metal music, reading about different lifestyles, and exploring my introverted side. My typical online hours are in the evenings, usually from 8 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, which has fueled my interest in creative communities and artistic expressions. My knowledge about sex dolls and other niche interests comes from a mix of online research and curiosity-driven exploration.
